Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Very easy. just write to your exchange counccelor

questions.answer: Many different. A very good advicer from USYD.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Very easy, and casual registration style. You can change units up until the first week of studying. Very unlike UCPH.

questions.answer: Dont only take hard units. Try some fun ones aswell.
